origin.description: Evaluate f on a grid and draw a surface mesh.
origin.usage: ezmesh(fn, xlim=c(-pi, pi), ylim=c(-pi, pi), n=60)
origin.details: The product grid. R time is that matrix, not a graphics device.
origin.value: Evaluate f on a grid and draw a surface mesh.
origin.example: { xx <- linspace(0, 1, 4); yy <- linspace(0, 1, 4); F <- matrix(NA, 4, 4); for (i in 1:4) for (j in 1:4) F[i,j] <- xx[i]*yy[j]; pdf(file.path(tempdir(),"p.pdf")); ezmesh(function(v) v[1]*v[2], c(0,1), c(0,1), n=4); dev.off(); as.numeric(F) }
